description: How an TmAppShell presents its navigation on a phone layout (a container narrower than the shell's mobile threshold). A phone has no room for the docked column or the tablet rail, so the navigation moves into a surface the user opens on demand, or into a bottom bar.

members.name: Drawer
members.description: The top bar carries a hamburger button that opens the full navigation in a modal TmDrawer (the default): focus enters the drawer, Escape / its close button / choosing an entry close it, and the focus returns to the hamburger. The drawer renders as a sibling of the frame (never inside its CSS size container).

members.name: BottomNavigation
members.description: The navigation is a TmBottomNavigation bar at the bottom of the frame, and no drawer exists: the top bar renders no hamburger. Entries come from BottomNavItems or are derived from the navigation model. The bar is a layout ROW of the frame, not viewport-fixed chrome.
